content: If Time Master and Time Slave transmit Pdelay_Resp for la- tency calculation (refer to PRS_TS_00012 in [1, PRS Time Synchronization Protocol]) the following sequence shall be applied: 1. Get a free transmission buffer via EthIf_ProvideTxBuffer 2. Activate the time stamping via EthIf_EnableEgressTimeStamp if EthTSyn- HardwareTimestampSupport is set to TRUE 3. Trigger transmit request via EthIf_Transmit
